vulnerabilityAlerts.description: GITHUB_TOKEN can't read Dependabot alerts, and nothing here is in an ecosystem they cover. Not for repos with osvVulnerabilityAlerts: Renovate forces these settings onto OSV security updates, so this would disable those too.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Renovate's nix manager refreshes a branch- or tag-tracking input only through a whole-lock `nix flake update` (per-input PRs need a rev pinned in flake.nix). The private site inputs are fetched through the git insteadOf rules in .github/workflows/renovate.yml.
prBodyNotes: This is `nix flake update` of every input, the site repos included, so their Caddy configs ship with it. Before merging: `make test-server`. Merging deploys it: the nightly auto-upgrade builds main.
